::: {#exm-hers-odds-ratio}
#### Odds ratio of regular exercise in HERS

Take group 1 to be hormone therapy and group 2, the [reference group](#def-reference-group), to be placebo.
The [odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) of regular exercise in each group
follow from the estimated [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of @exm-hers-outcome-risk.
The estimated [odds ratio](#def-odds-ratio) divides the odds in the hormone therapy group
by the odds in the placebo group:

```{r}
#| label: hers-odds-ratio
#| code-fold: false
odds_hat <- risk_hat / (1 - risk_hat)
or_hat <- odds_hat[["hormone therapy"]] / odds_hat[["placebo"]]
c(odds_hat, odds_ratio = or_hat)
```

The estimated odds ratio `{r} round(or_hat, 3)` is close to the
[risk ratio](#def-risk-ratio) `{r} round(rr_hat, 3)` of @exm-hers-risk-ratio,
because the two groups have nearly equal risks.
The odds ratio is 1 exactly when the risk ratio is 1,
so it also agrees with the large [p-value](inference.qmd#def-p-value) of @exm-hers-chisq.
:::
